cases.request: Review report.py for worthwhile simplifications. It is long; should we split it into smaller helpers? Report findings only; do not edit files.

files.README.md:
# Finance export

export_row builds one CSV row per order. Finance imports the columns in exactly this order. Orders come from the validated order store.
files.report.py:
def export_row(order):
    """One CSV row per order, in the column order finance imports."""
    customer = order["customer"]
    address = customer["address"]
    return [
        order["id"],
        order["created_at"].date().isoformat(),
        customer["id"],
        customer["name"],
        customer["email"],
        address["line1"],
        address.get("line2", ""),
        address["city"],
        address["postcode"],
        address["country"],
        order["currency"],
        f"{order['subtotal']:.2f}",
        f"{order['tax']:.2f}",
        f"{order['shipping']:.2f}",
        f"{order['total']:.2f}",
        order["payment_method"],
        order["status"],
        len(order["lines"]),
        order.get("coupon", ""),
        order["channel"],
    ]

expectations: Leaves all fixture files unchanged and creates no files.
Does not recommend splitting export_row into helpers only because of its length, and explains that it does one job in a straight line.
Does not recommend changing the column order, the number formatting, or adding validation for fields the order store already guarantees.
Reports no actionable simplification, or only findings that name a concrete case, rather than style changes.
